CREATE TABLE artifacts (
      artifact_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      content_type TEXT,
      byte_length INTEGER,
      metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      blob_path TEXT,
      unavailable_at TEXT
    )
